**Test image observations:** Mango leaf, mostly green, with significant brown necrotic tissue at the tip/apex, and scattered brown lesions on the leaf blade. The necrosis is concentrated at the tip with some marginal involvement.

**Reference comparison:** The Die_Back reference shows a fully desiccated, completely brown curled leaf — severe end-stage dieback. The test image is only partially necrotic, with the necrosis starting at the tip but scattered lesions also present on the blade.

**Reasoning:** The scattered brown lesions across the leaf blade combined with tip/margin necrosis is more characteristic of Anthracnose (which causes irregular brown-to-black spots, often initiating at leaf tips and margins). Die_Back typically progresses as a uniform necrotic front from tip downward without discrete scattered spots on the still-green portion.
